lines.text: Balaam turned his face toward the wilderness instead of seeking omens, and the Spirit of God came upon him.
Balaam said Israel's tents were lovely, and that God brought them out of Egypt with strength like a wild ox.
Balak struck his hands together in anger and told Balaam to flee home, saying Chemosh had denied his reward.
Balaam said a star would come from Jacob and crush the skulls of Edom, and Amalek would be destroyed.
Balaam said Asshur would take the Kenites captive, and then he returned home while Balak went his way.
